en: A colored postcard showing a picturesque European town with a river flowing through the foreground, red-roofed buildings, a church tower, bridges, and a prominent rocky hill topped with fortifications. On the hill stands a distinctive clock tower. The background shows rolling, hilly terrain with some snow or light coloration. The top left of the postcard has the text 'GRAZ Mur Schlossberg.'
